items.title: Bitcoin ETF Investors Head for the Exits After Record Binance Hack
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw $643.2 million in outflows Friday, the first full trading session after the $6.4 billion Binance hack, ending October with roughly $516 million in net outflows.

items.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
items.summary: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this number to continue growing.

items.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
items.summary: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings.

items.title: Tether’s excess reserves nearly double to $8B as Q3 profit hits $1.5B
items.summary: The stablecoin issuer’s US Treasury holdings are comparable to those of major foreign holders, while its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion at the end of September.
